verdict.rationale: GitHub's REST API docs confirm that you can create fine-grained personal access tokens and grant them a specific set of permissions. They also return an `X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions` header telling you which permissions an endpoint requires. The evidence only covers the permissions part of the story; nothing shown documents limiting a token to specific repositories or setting an expiry date. missing for 10: evidence of per-repository token scoping, evidence of token expiry-date configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
